nodes.name: Theorem 1.4: Smooth numbers in APs
Lemma 3.2: Contribution of small-conductor characters
nodes.statement:
There exist constants $\varepsilon, \delta, C > 0$ such that for $(\log x)^C \le y \le x$, $Q \le x$ and $A > 0$, one has
\[
    \sum_{q \le Q} \frac{1}{\varphi(q)} \sum_{\substack{\chi \ (\textnormal{mod } q) \\ 1 < \textnormal{cond}(\chi) \le x^\varepsilon}} 
    \left\vert \sum_{n \in S(x, y)} \chi(n) \right\vert \ll_A 
    \Psi(x, y) 
    \left(H(u)^{-\delta} (\log x)^{-A} + y^{-\delta} \right),
\]
where $u := (\log x)/(\log y)$. The implicit constant is effective if $A < 1$.

nodes.name: Theorem 4.1: Triple convolution estimate
nodes.statement:
For all sufficiently small $\varepsilon > 0$, there exists $\delta > 0$ such that the following holds. Let $a_1, a_2$ be coprime nonzero integers, and let $M, N, L, x > 2$ satisfy
\begin{equation}
\begin{gathered}
    a_1, a_2 \ll x^\delta, 
    \qquad 
    MNL \asymp x,
    \qquad\quad 
    x^{(1-\varepsilon)/2} \ll R \ll x^{-5\varepsilon} NL \ll x^{(2/3) - 11\varepsilon},
    \qquad 
    N^9 L^8 \ll x^3 R^4,
    \\
    N \ll \frac{x^{1-2\varepsilon}}{R}, \qquad\quad N^4 L^7 \max(1, N/L)^{2\theta} \ll x^{2-16\varepsilon}R^2, 
    \qquad 
    N^{12-6\theta} L^{11-6\theta} \ll x^{6-4(\theta+\varepsilon)} R^2,
\end{gathered}
\end{equation}
for $\theta = \theta_{\max}$.
Then for any $1$-bounded complex sequences $(\alpha_m)$, $(\beta_n)$, $(\gamma_\ell)$, one has
\begin{equation} 
    \sum_{\substack{r \sim R \\ (r, a_1a_2) = 1}}
    \left\vert \sum_{m \sim M} \sum_{n \sim N} \sum_{\ell \sim L} \alpha_m \beta_n \gamma_\ell\,
    \mathcal{E}_D(mn\ell \overline{a_1} a_2; r)
    \right\vert
    \ll_\varepsilon  
    \frac{x (\log x)^4}{\min\left(x^\delta, \sqrt{D}\right)},
\end{equation}
for all $1 \le D \le x^\varepsilon$.

Proposition 6.1: Contribution of main terms
nodes.statement:
With the notation above, one has

    0 \le X_1 - 2\textnormal{Re} X_2 + X_3 \ll \frac{K^2}{RD} (\log x)^6,

nodes.name: Lemma 3.3: Large sieve
nodes.statement:
For $Q, M, N \ge 1$ and any sequence $(a_n)$ of complex numbers, one has
\[
    \sum_{q \le Q} \frac{q}{\varphi(q)} \sum_{\substack{\chi \ (\textnormal{mod } q) \\ \chi \textnormal{ primitive}}} 
    \left\vert 
    \sum_{M < n \le M+N} a_n \chi(n)
    \right\vert^2
    \le 
    (N + Q^2 - 1) 
    \sum_{M < n \le M+N} |a_n|^2.
\]

nodes.name: Proposition 8.4, Proposition 9.4: Improved BFI-style bound
Lemma 3.8: Incomplete Weil bound
nodes.statement:
Let $x > 1$, $1 < M \ll x$, and let $n, c, k, \ell \ll x$ be positive integers. Then for any $\varepsilon > 0$, one has
\[
    \sum_{\substack{(m, ck) = 1 \\ \ell \mid m \le M}} 
    \frac{m}{\varphi(m)} \textnormal{e}\left(\frac{\overline{m}n}{c}\right)
    \ll_{\varepsilon}
    x^\varepsilon \left((n, c)^{1/2} c^{1/2} + \frac{(n, c)}{\ell c} M \right).
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 3.6: Gauss sum bound
nodes.statement:
For any $a \in \mathbf{Z}$, $q \in \mathbf{Z}_+$, and Dirichlet character $\chi \ (\textnormal{mod } q)$, one has
\[
    \left\vert \sum_{b \in \mathbf{Z}/q\mathbf{Z}} \chi(b)\ \textnormal{e}\left(\frac{ab}{q}\right) \right\vert
    \le 
    \textnormal{cond}(\chi)^{1/2} \sum_{d \mid (a, q)} d.
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 3.4: Truncated Poisson
nodes.statement:
Let $C > 0$, $x > 1$, $1 < M \ll x$, and $\Phi : \mathbf{R} \to \mathbf{R}$ be a smooth function supported in $[1/10, 10]$ such that $||\Phi^{(j)}||_\infty \ll_j (\log x)^{jC}$ for $j \ge 0$. Then for all positive integers $q \ll x$, any $a \in \mathbf{Z}/q\mathbf{Z}$, and any $\varepsilon > 0$, $H \ge x^{\varepsilon} qM^{-1}$, one has
\[
    \sum_{m \equiv a \ (\textnormal{mod } q)} \Phi\left(\frac{m}{M}\right) = \frac{M}{q} \sum_{|h| \le H} \widehat{\Phi} \left(\frac{hM}{q} \right) \textnormal{e}\left(\frac{ah}{q}\right)
    + 
    O_{\varepsilon,C}\left(x^{-100}\right).
\]

nodes.name: Lemma 3.5: Completion of Kloosterman sums
nodes.statement:
Let $C, x, M, \Phi$ be as in 3.4. Then for all positive integers $c, q \ll x$ with $(c, q) = 1$, any $a \in \mathbf{Z}/q\mathbf{Z}$, $n \in \mathbf{Z}/c\mathbf{Z}$, and any $\varepsilon > 0$, $H \ge x^\varepsilon cq M^{-1}$, one has
\[
    \sum_{\substack{m \equiv a \ (\textnormal{mod } q) \\ (m, c) = 1}} 
    \Phi\left(\frac{m}{M}\right) \textnormal{e}\left(\frac{\overline{m}n}{c}\right)
    =
    \frac{M}{cq} \sum_{|h| \le H} \widehat{\Phi}\left(\frac{hM}{cq}\right) \textnormal{e}\left(\frac{ah \overline{c}}{q}\right)
    S(h\overline{q}, n; c)
    +  
    O_{\varepsilon, C}\left(x^{-100}\right).
\]

nodes.name: Theorem 3.9: DI-type Kloosterman sum bound
nodes.statement:
Let $1 \ll M, N, R, S, C \ll x^{O(1)}$, $(a_{m,r,s})$ be a complex sequence supported in $m \sim M, r \sim R, s \sim S$, and $\omega \in \mathbf{R}/\mathbf{Z}$. Also, let $g(t)$ be a smooth function supported on $t \asymp 1$, with bounded derivatives $||g^{(j)}||_\infty \ll_{j} 1$ for $j \ge 0$. Then for any $\eta > 0$, one has
\[
\begin{aligned}
    \sum_{\substack{r \sim R \\ s \sim S \\ (r, s) = 1}}
    \sum_{m \sim M} a_{m,r,s} \sum_{n \sim N} \textnormal{e}(n\omega)
    \sum_{(c, r) = 1} g\left(\frac{c}{C}\right)\, S(m\overline{r}, \pm n; sc)
    \ll_\eta 
    x^\eta\,
    \left(1 + \frac{C}{R\sqrt{S}}\right)^{\theta_{\max}}\, 
    ||a_{m,r,s}||_2
    \\
    \times 
    \sqrt{NRS}
    \left(\frac{C^2}{R} (M + RS)(N + RS) + MN \right)^{1/2},
\end{aligned}
\]
where we recall that $\theta_{\max} \le 7/32$ by A. (The `$\pm n$' notation indicates that either consistent choice of sign is allowable.)
